summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by ASML Holding N.V., a foreign private issuer, reporting its Q2 2026 financial results. The filing includes a press release, presentation, and interim financial statements covering total net sales of €9.3 billion, net income of €2.9 billion, and an increased 2026 outlook of €43-45 billion in net sales with 54-56% gross margin. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes; it is a routine quarterly earnings report.
